# none
run --detach --name sbx_0123456789abcdef --label sbx.managed=1 --cpus 2 --memory 2048M --mount type=bind,source=/usr/local/libexec/sandboxd,target=/.sbx,readonly --network none -- img:1 /.sbx/sandbox-guestd idle
# open
run --detach --name sbx_0123456789abcdef --label sbx.managed=1 --cpus 2 --memory 2048M --mount type=bind,source=/usr/local/libexec/sandboxd,target=/.sbx,readonly -- img:1 /.sbx/sandbox-guestd idle
# exec
exec --interactive sbx_0123456789abcdef /.sbx/sandbox-guestd serve --stdio
